sub_agent_reviews.summary: One unified Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety for the 2026-07-27 UTC window; APPA was excluded as already live and ContainmentBench was selected from the same table.
Read arXiv metadata, PDF text, and HTML full text; extracted trace graph definitions, policy semantics, evidence stages, result tables, diagnostics, limitations, and artifact boundaries.
Checked public references around AgentDojo and NeuroTaint; third-party deep commentary is sparse because the paper appeared on 2026-07-27.

Dedupe found APPA already published and no ContainmentBench markers in the clean origin/data worktree; the article explicitly preserves single-model, synthetic-workflow, ledger-oracle, and adaptive-coverage limitations.
Wrote a 5000-plus CJK Markdown article with tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid-free structured diagrams; no image localization was needed.
